title: M.Sc. Mathematics
eligibility: Pass B.Sc. Mathematics, or another university examination with more than one major including Mathematics accepted as equivalent by the Syndicate.
Complete a recognised three-year undergraduate degree or the prescribed credits/equivalent qualification, plus this award’s specific conditions.
University eligibility acceptance and the applicable selection/document-verification process remain separate admission requirements.

title: M.A. Economics
eligibility: Pass B.A. Economics / Corporate Economics / Business Economics, B.Com. in any branch, B.Sc. Mathematics / Statistics, BBA, or an equivalent examination approved by the Syndicate.
Complete a recognised three-year undergraduate degree or the prescribed credits/equivalent qualification, plus this award’s specific conditions.
University eligibility acceptance and the applicable selection/document-verification process remain separate admission requirements.

title: M.Com. General
eligibility: Pass B.Com., B.Com. Corporate Secretaryship/Bank Management, BCS, BBA, BA Co-operation/Economics/Corporate Economics, or a Syndicate-accepted equivalent.
Listed B.Sc. Mathematics/Computer Science, BCA or B.Sc. ISM applicants require any two B.Com.-level core papers; obtain eligibility acceptance for the exact prior studies.
Complete a recognised three-year undergraduate degree or the prescribed credits/equivalent qualification, plus this award’s specific conditions.
University eligibility acceptance and the applicable selection/document-verification process remain separate admission requirements.

title: M.A. Tamil
eligibility: A bachelor’s degree with Tamil as main subject or Tamil as a subject, or an equivalent degree approved by the Syndicate. Candidates with Tamil as their main subject receive preference.
Complete a recognised three-year undergraduate degree or the prescribed credits/equivalent qualification, plus this award’s specific conditions.
University eligibility acceptance and the applicable selection/document-verification process remain separate admission requirements.

title: M.A. English
eligibility: B.A. of this university with English as the main subject; or an examination of another university accepted by the Syndicate as equivalent.
Alternative route: B.A./B.Sc. with Part II English, or B.Com./BBA/BCA/BCS or another such degree with one year Part II English; the regulation specifies at least 55% for this route.
Complete a recognised three-year undergraduate degree or the prescribed credits/equivalent qualification, plus this award’s specific conditions.
University eligibility acceptance and the applicable selection/document-verification process remain separate admission requirements.
